text: 有消息称，港交所据悉将于2026年底前推出首个债券指数。对此，港交所有关负责人回应称，港交所正在筹备推出首个债券指数，以支持人民币国际化进程和香港多元资产生态系统的持续发展，期待在未来适当时候分享更多详情。 （中证金牛座）
text_en: It is reported that HKEX is expected to launch its first bond index by the end of 2026. In response, a relevant HKEX official said that HKEX is preparing to launch its first bond index to support the process of RMB internationalization and the continued development of Hong Kong's diversified asset ecosystem, and looks forward to sharing more details at an appropriate time in the future. (CSI Taurus)
